map.检查网页/文章中的关键词密度，帮助SEO优化: Check keyword density in a page or article to support SEO optimization
map.📖 查看「SEO关键词密度检查器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "SEO Keyword Density Checker User Guide"
map.关键词密度：中文按字符计、英文按词计，密度 = 关键词出现次数 ÷ 总词数 ×: Keyword density: Chinese is counted by characters and English by words, density = keyword occurrences / total words × 100%; aim to keep keyword density between 1% and 2.5%.
map.写 SEO 文章时检测目标词是否堆砌或不足。: When writing an SEO article, check whether the target word is stuffed or underused.
map.中文按「出现字数/总中文字数」、英文按「词频/总词数」算密度。: Chinese uses characters found over total Chinese characters and English uses word frequency over total words.
map.给出 1%–3% 健康区间建议。: A healthy range of 1%-3% is recommended.
map.关键词「减肥」出现 5 次（每词 2 字共 10 字），正文总中文 500 字: The keyword "weight loss" appears 5 times (2 characters each, 10 characters total) in a body of 500 Chinese characters, so density = (10/500)×100 = 2%, inside the healthy 1%-3% range.
map.同词出现 20 次（40 字）/500 字 → 密度 8% 过高，可能被判定堆砌: The same word appearing 20 times (40 characters) in 500 characters gives 8%, which is too high and may be judged as stuffing; dilute it to about 5 occurrences.
map.密度 1%–3% 是铁律吗？: Is a density of 1%-3% a hard rule?
map.是经验区间，不是算法硬线。重点在自然通顺，硬凑密度反而伤体验与被降权。: It is a rule of thumb, not an algorithmic threshold. Natural readability matters most; forcing density hurts both experience and ranking.
map.中英文算法为什么不同？: Why do the Chinese and English algorithms differ?
map.中文无空格分词，按字频更稳；英文按词频。工具自动区分处理。: Chinese has no spaces to segment words, so character frequency is more stable; English uses word frequency. The tool distinguishes the two automatically.
map.SEO关键词密度检查器。营销分析工具，帮助量化评估营销效果与 ROI。: SEO keyword density checker. A marketing analytics tool for quantifying campaign performance and ROI.
